current_suggestion.pitch: Your current channels cover the mechanics of discipline and health science rigorously, but Better Ideas covers the phenomenology of motivation, identity, and meaning-making in a way that complements Stoic philosophy without recycling hustle-culture platitudes. Joey writes and narrates personal essays — genuinely long-form in spirit even when short in runtime — exploring why people struggle to act on what they already know, drawing on philosophy, psychology, and lived experience. The tone is closer to Seneca than to a productivity influencer, and his video on 'being a fair witness to yourself' is the kind of thing that sits with you.
